items.q: Yellow lower leaves, soggy soil, musty smell.
options: Overwatering: let it dry out, check the roots
items.why: Soggy soil and a musty smell point to overwatering and possibly root rot.

items.q: Brown, crispy leaf tips on a calathea.
Long, stretched stems reaching for the window.
items.why: Leggy growth means the plant is stretching for light.

items.q: White cottony fluff where leaves meet stems.
options: Mealybugs: wipe off with rubbing alcohol

items.q: Bleached, pale patches on leaves after a sunny week.
options: Sun scorch: move to indirect light
Thirsty: water thoroughly until it drains

items.q: Tiny flies hovering over the soil.
options: Fungus gnats: let the soil dry between waterings
Spider mites: shower the leaves, raise humidity

items.q: Roots poking out of the drainage hole.
Leaves suddenly dropping after you moved it.
options: Shock from the move: keep it steady and wait
